title: Where procurement strategy meets analytics.
text:
Procurement  ·  Strategy  ·  Analytics
      Where procurement strategy meets analytics.
      I'm Alyssa, a global procurement leader who has built and scaled sourcing organizations across retail, consumer, and digital commerce brands. Today I lead Global Indirect Procurement at Ralph Lauren, and I'm earning an MS in Applied Business Analytics at Boston University to bring sharper data to the decisions procurement makes every day.
      
        View my work
        Read my CV
      
    
    
      
    
  



  
    
      $2BAnnual spend led
      $100M+Cost savings delivered
      6Global consumer brands
    
  



  
    
      Why analytics, why now
      Procurement has always run on data. It just hasn't always used it well.
    
    
      Procurement sits on some of the richest data in any company: every supplier, every contract, every dollar that leaves the building. Yet in my experience, analytics is one of the least invested-in capabilities in the function. Too many sourcing decisions still start in a spreadsheet someone rebuilt from scratch.
      That gap matters more than ever. Supply-chain volatility, cost pressure, and AI are changing how quickly organizations need to see risk and act on opportunity. I went back to school to build the technical foundation (SQL, Spark, cloud platforms, and data visualization) so I can lead that shift rather than wait for it.
    
  



  
    What I bring
    Three lenses, one leader
    
      
        
        Strategic Sourcing
        Category strategy, supplier negotiation, and vendor performance across marketing, technology, logistics, facilities, and corporate services.
      
      
        
        Enterprise Transformation
        Standing up centralized procurement functions, procure-to-pay and ERP rollouts, M&A integration, and the change management that makes them stick.
      
      
        
        Analytics & Insight
        Spend visibility, KPI frameworks, and dashboards, now backed by hands-on work in Python, SQL, Spark, and cloud analytics.
      
    
  



  
    Where I'm headed
    I want to lead procurement organizations where analytics is a core capability, not an afterthought: predictive spend insight, early supplier-risk signals, and decision tools that let teams move faster with confidence.
  



  
    Brands I've built with
    
      TargetStarbucksTapestryRevlonFanaticsRalph Lauren
    
  



  
    
      
        Beyond the office
        Leading in the community
      
      
        As Community Senior Council Head with the New York Junior League, I oversee the League's Community area: the councils and committees that partner with organizations across New York City to improve the health and well-being of women, children, and families. In my role, I'm working to better capture and report our volunteer impact, bringing the same process and data discipline I use at work to a mission I care about.
        I also serve on the Leadership Council of The Pink Agenda.
      
    
    
      25Committees

    Last year, Community committees delivered 530+ events and 6,300+ volunteer hours across New York City. The NYJL has 2,500+ volunteers overall.
